# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in the Asistente EIT UDP project, please report it responsibly:

1. **GitHub Private Security Advisory:** Open a [Security Advisory](https://github.com/victorbarrera1/asistente-eit/security/advisories/new).
2. **Email:** Contact the maintainer directly at `ingenieria.informatica@mail.udp.cl`.

We will respond within 48 hours to investigate and release a security fix.
